Appearance:
 Shri Brijesh Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Tarun Pagare - Govt. Adv. appearing on behalf of A  General.
ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case-dairy.

2] This is applicant's Sixth repeat application filed under Section Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.10/2023 registered at Police Station GRP Ratlam (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 201, 406, 410 of the IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 21.04.2025.
Applicant's earlier three bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn and two bail applications were allowed temporarily.
3] The allegation against the applicant is that he duped the complainant for a sum of Rs. 6,49,000/-.

4] Counsel for the applicant at the outset, has submitted that out of the aforesaid amount,
Rs.3,60,000/-which was obtained by the applicant in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:17450 2 MCRC-21837-2025 his account, he would be depositing upfront in the trial court and the remaining amount shall be allowed to be deposited by him in certain monthly installments, and for this purpose, further five months time may be granted.
5] Counsel for the respondent/on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: ] On due consideration of the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case diary, as also the documents filed on record, and the undertaking given by the counsel for the applicant, this Court is inclined to allow the bail application subject to certain stringent condition.
Accordingly, without adverting to the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 483 of the BNSS, on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed.

7] The applicant is directed that upon the applicant's or any other person on his behalf, depositing a sum of Rs.3,60,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Sixty Thousand only) before his release i.e. at the time of furnishing the bail bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and rest of Rs.2,89,000/-(Rupees Two Lakhs Eighty Nine Thousand only) to be deposited by the applicant in six equal installments within a period of five months from the date of his release in a fix deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and the said amount shall be subject to the final outcome of the case by the trial Court.

The deposit receipt/certificate so produced by the applicant shall be endorsed by the learned Judge of the lower Court to be,
'furnished NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17450 3 MCRC-21837-2025 towards the bail of the applicants and shall be subject to the final decision of the case by the trial Court'.
8] It is further directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, to appear before the trial Court on the dates given by the Court.
This bail order shall be subject to furnishing an undertaking that the applicant will deposit the amount respectively as directed above.
The applicant shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S. 9]
With the aforesaid, the M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy, as per rules.
